'''Skydrummer''' is an [[Alpha enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|A howlerbeast that grew up in the wilderness. This beast is indigenous to Talos-II. Strong membranes on its head and neck allow it to unleash powerful howling loud enough to shake the hills and forests.}}
